title: A timed test is allowed, and a hang guard is a good use of one; a speed-dependent verdict uses a synthetic clock.
ruling: Owner chat answer, 2026-11-07 13:00 CST, to page item 345 (time-pinned-hang-guards), with none of the options: "P5 never meant to ban timed waits. A timed test is allowed, and catching a hung test is a good reason for one. A test whose verdict depends on speed uses a synthetic clock, so machine load cannot change it." Decision test-practices P5 is rewritten to this in PR 1958 (replaces 1177). The words are triage's relay of the chat answer, not the owner's typed text. Covers PRs 1147, 1958, 2002.
